comment: Fallback cycle of 13 days, used when no generated plan exists for a date. Not tied to dates or season.

meals.name: Moong Dal Chilla with Pudina Chutney
meals.desc: Protein se bharpoor, kam tel mein.
steps: Moong dal 3 ghante bhigo kar mirch ke saath pees lein.
Tawa par patla chilla failayein, thoda tel lagayein.
Dono taraf sek kar pudina-dahi chutney ke saath parosein.

meals.name: Lauki Chana Dal with Phulka
steps: Chana dal ko 30 minute bhigo dein.
Jeera, tamatar, lauki aur dal ko haldi-namak ke saath cooker mein pakayein.
Phulke sek kar garam sabzi ke saath dein.

meals.name: Palak Paneer with Roti
meals.desc: Hare palak aur paneer ka classic jodi.
steps: Palak ko ubaal kar mixer mein pees lein.
Pyaaz-tamatar bhunein, palak puree aur masale daalein.
Paneer ke tukde daal kar 3 minute pakayein, roti ke saath parosein.

meals.name: Poha with Moongfali
steps: Poha dhokar chhan lein.
Tel mein rai, moongfali, pyaaz aur mirch bhunein.
Poha, haldi, namak mila kar 2 minute dhak dein, nimbu nichod dein.

meals.name: Rajma Chawal with Kachumber
steps: Rajma raat bhar bhigo kar cooker mein ubaal lein.
Pyaaz-tamatar ka masala bhun kar rajma daalein aur 15 minute pakayein.
Chawal ke saath garam parosein, kachumber side mein.

meals.name: Bhindi Masala with Dal Tadka and Roti
steps: Bhindi dho kar sukha lein aur kaat lein.
Pyaaz ke saath bhindi ko dhak kar pakayein, masale daalein.
Dal ubaal kar lahsun-jeera ka tadka lagayein, roti ke saath dein.

meals.name: Vegetable Upma
meals.desc: Sooji aur sabziyon ka halka nashta.
steps: Sooji ko sukha bhun kar alag rakh lein.
Tel mein rai, pyaaz, sabziyan aur curry patta bhunein.
Paani daal kar ubalne par sooji daalein aur 3 minute dhak dein.

meals.name: Kadhi Chawal
steps: Dahi, besan aur paani ko achhe se phent lein.
Dheemi aanch par ubaal aane tak hilate rahein, 15 minute pakayein.
Jeera-curry patta ka tadka lagayein, chawal ke saath dein.

meals.name: Masala Anda Bhurji with Multigrain Roti
steps: Pyaaz, tamatar, mirch ko tel mein bhunein.
Anda phod kar daalein, masale daal kar bhurji banayein.
Garam multigrain roti ke saath parosein.

days.note: Aloo paratha, par kam ghee ke saath.

meals.name: Aloo Paratha with Dahi
steps: Ubale aloo mash karke namak, mirch, dhaniya mila lein.
Atta ki loi mein bharwan bhar kar belein.
Tawa par thode ghee se dono taraf sekein, dahi ke saath dein.

meals.name: Masoor Dal with Turai Sabzi and Phulka
steps: Masoor dal ko haldi-namak ke saath 3 seeti tak pakayein.
Turai ko jeera, tamatar ke saath dhak kar pakayein.
Dal par tadka lagayein, phulka ke saath dein.

meals.name: Mix Veg Pulao with Raita
steps: Chawal dho kar 20 minute bhigo dein.
Tel mein jeera, tej patta aur sabziyan bhun kar chawal daalein.
Dugna paani daal kar dhak dein, dahi ka raita bana kar parosein.

days.note: Dahi aur fruit ka halka nashta.

meals.name: Paneer Sandwich (Brown Bread)
steps: Paneer crumble karke kati sabziyon aur namak-kali mirch ke saath mila lein.
Bread par chutney lagayein, filling bhar dein.
Tawa ya toaster mein sunehra hone tak sek lein.

meals.name: Arhar Dal with Aloo Gobhi and Roti
steps: Dal ko cooker mein pakayein aur tadka lagayein.
Aloo-gobhi ko adrak, haldi, dhaniya ke saath dhak kar pakayein.
Garam roti ke saath dein.

meals.name: Masala Khichdi with Dahi and Achaar
meals.desc: Halka aur santulit raat ka khana.
steps: Chawal aur moong dal ko dho lein.
Ghee-jeera ka tadka karke haldi, namak ke saath cooker mein pakayein.
Garam khichdi dahi aur achaar ke saath dein.

meals.name: Sooji Cheela with Vegetables
steps: Sooji aur dahi ka ghol 15 minute rakhein.
Kati sabziyan mila kar tawa par patla failayein.
Dono taraf sek kar chutney ke saath dein.

meals.name: Kala Chana Curry with Phulka
steps: Chana raat bhar bhigo kar cooker mein ubaal lein.
Pyaaz-tamatar ka masala bhun kar chana daalein.
10 minute pakayein, phulka ke saath dein.

meals.name: Baingan Bharta with Roti
steps: Baingan ko seedhi aanch par bhun lein, chhilka utar kar mash karein.
Lahsun, pyaaz, tamatar bhunein.
Baingan daal kar 5 minute pakayein, roti ke saath dein.

days.note: Ravivar ka khaas lunch: chhole bhature.

meals.name: Methi Thepla with Dahi
steps: Kati methi, atta, besan aur masale mila kar naram atta goonth lein.
Patla bel kar tawa par sekein.
Dahi ke saath parosein.

meals.name: Chhole Bhature (Baked Bhature)
meals.desc: Ravivar ka special, kam tel mein.
steps: Chane raat bhar bhigo kar chai-patti ke saath ubaal lein.
Pyaaz-tamatar masala bhun kar chole aur chole masala daalein, 15 minute pakayein.
Maida aur dahi ka atta goonth kar bhature bel lein, oven ya tawa par sekein.

meals.name: Palak Dal with Jeera Rice
meals.desc: Halka dinner, bhari dopahar ke baad.
steps: Dal aur kata palak cooker mein pakayein.
Lahsun-jeera ka tadka lagayein.
Jeera daale chawal ke saath dein.

meals.name: Masala Omelette with Toast
steps: Anda phent kar kati pyaaz, mirch, dhaniya aur namak mila lein.
Tawa par thode tel mein omelette sekein.
Toast ke saath garam parosein.

meals.name: Soya Chunk Pulao with Raita
steps: Soya chunks garam paani mein bhigo kar nichod lein.
Tel mein masale, pyaaz, matar aur soya bhunein.
Chawal aur paani daal kar pakayein, raita ke saath dein.

meals.name: Mixed Dal with Gobhi Sabzi and Roti
steps: Mixed dal ko cooker mein pakayein, tadka lagayein.
Gobhi ko adrak-jeera ke saath dhak kar pakayein.
Roti ke saath dein.

days.note: Namkeen dalia se din ki shuruaat.

meals.name: Namkeen Dalia with Vegetables
meals.desc: Fiber wala, dil ke liye achha.
steps: Tel mein jeera, pyaaz aur sabziyan bhunein.
Dalia daal kar 2 minute bhunein.
Teen guna paani daal kar naram hone tak pakayein.

meals.name: Dal Makhani (Light) with Roti
steps: Urad aur rajma raat bhar bhigo kar cooker mein khoob pakayein.
Tamatar puree aur masale mila kar dheemi aanch par 20 minute pakayein.
Thoda makhan daal kar roti ke saath dein.

meals.name: Aloo Methi with Roti and Dahi
meals.desc: Sardiyon ka favourite, kam masale mein.
steps: Aloo kaat kar lahsun-jeera ke saath bhunein.
Methi daal kar 5 minute dhak kar pakayein.
Roti aur dahi ke saath dein.

meals.name: Gobhi Paratha with Dahi
steps: Gobhi kaddukas karke nichod lein, masale mila lein.
Atta mein bharwan bhar kar parathe belein.
Tawa par sekein, dahi ke saath dein.

meals.name: Palak Dal with Rice and Salad
steps: Dal aur palak cooker mein pakayein.
Jeera-lahsun ka tadka lagayein.
Chawal aur kheera-gajar salad ke saath dein.

meals.name: Egg Curry with Roti
steps: Ande ubaal kar chhil lein aur ek-ek cheera laga dein.
Pyaaz-tamatar ka masala bhun kar paani daalein.
Ande daal kar 5 minute pakayein, roti ke saath dein.

meals.name: Masala Oats with Vegetables
steps: Tel mein jeera, pyaaz aur sabziyan bhunein.
Paani aur masale daal kar ubalein.
Oats daal kar 3 minute pakayein.

meals.name: Lobia Curry with Rice
steps: Lobia 4 ghante bhigo kar cooker mein ubaal lein.
Pyaaz-tamatar-adrak ka masala bhunein.
Lobia daal kar 10 minute pakayein, chawal ke saath dein.

meals.name: Tawa Sabzi with Roti
meals.desc: Mix sabziyon ki masaledar tawa sabzi.
steps: Tawa par tel mein tamatar aur masale bhunein.
Kati sabziyan daal kar dhak kar pakayein.
Tawa par hi mash kar roti ke saath dein.

meals.name: Paneer Paratha with Chaas
steps: Paneer crumble karke masale mila lein.
Atta mein bharwan bhar kar parathe belein.
Thode ghee se sek kar chaas ke saath dein.

meals.name: Dahi Wale Aloo with Dal and Roti
steps: Aloo ubaal kar tukde kar lein, jeera ke saath bhunein.
Phenti dahi aur masale daal kar 5 minute pakayein.
Moong dal tadka aur roti ke saath dein.

meals.name: Mushroom Matar with Phulka
steps: Pyaaz-tamatar ka masala bhunein.
Mushroom aur matar daal kar 8 minute pakayein.
Phulka ke saath garam dein.

meals.name: Missi Roti with Dahi and Achaar
meals.desc: Besan aur atta ki khushboodar roti.
steps: Besan, atta, ajwain, namak aur hari mirch ka atta goonth lein.
Roti bel kar tawa par sekein.
Dahi aur achaar ke saath dein.

meals.name: Tamatar Dhaniya Dal with Jeera Aloo and Roti
steps: Dal tamatar ke saath pakayein, dhaniya daal dein.
Aloo ko jeera ke saath bhun kar pakayein.
Roti ke saath dein.

meals.name: Bharwan Shimla Mirch with Roti
steps: Aloo mash karke besan aur masale mila kar bharwan bana lein.
Shimla mirch mein bharwan bhar dein.
Tawa par dhak kar dheemi aanch par pakayein, roti ke saath dein.
